body.name: v2.0.0
body.body:
gt 2.0.0 brings gt's flags and JSON output in line with `gh`, keeps settings and stored tokens readable across versions, works with narrowly scoped CI tokens, and fixes many bugs.

## Breaking changes

- **`--json` and `--csv` require a field list.** Like gh, `--json` without fields fails with a usage error that lists the available fields. Use `--jq .` or `--template` to read every field. gt no longer guesses whether the word after `--json` is a field list or an argument ([#127](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/127)).
- **Absent values in JSON are `null`.** A field without a value is now `null` instead of `""` or a missing key, an empty list is `[]`, and every declared field is always present. Timestamps are RFC 3339 in UTC to the second. Fields that cost extra requests, such as reviewers or `blocked_by`, are read only when `--json` names them or the `--jq`/`--template` expression mentions them ([#127](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/127)).
- **`gt pr merge` uses gh's flag names:** `--message` is now `--body` (`-b`), `--message-file` is `--body-file` (`-F`) and `--title` is `--subject` (`-t`). `-s` is now `--squash` instead of `--method`, and `--merge` and `--rebase` gain `-m` and `-r`. `--method` stays, long-only, for Gitea's other merge styles ([#125](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/125)).
- **Renamed or removed flags, matching gh** ([#126](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/126)):
  - Teams are requested as `ORG/TEAM` in `pr create --reviewer`, `pr edit --add-reviewer`/`--remove-reviewer` and `pr review request`/`cancel-request --reviewer`. `--reviewer-team`, `--add-reviewer-team`, `--remove-reviewer-team` and `--team` are removed.
  - `pr create --allow-maintainer-edits` is now `--no-maintainer-edit`.
  - `search issue|pr` replaces `--assigned`, `--authored` and `--mentioned` with `--assignee`, `--author` and `--mentions`, which take a user or `@me`.
  - `repo edit --actions` is now `--enable-actions`, and `repo edit --private` is removed in favour of `--visibility`.
  - The hidden `--before` of `gt notification` is removed; use `--until`.
- `gt issue edit` and `gt pr edit` rename `--add-blocks`/`--remove-blocks` to gh's `--add-blocking`/`--remove-blocking` ([#99](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/99)).
- Plain output is smaller for scripts and agents: job logs print without Gitea's per-line timestamp (`--timestamps` keeps it), `run logs --failed` and `run view --log-failed` print only the failed steps, and piped lists shorten commit IDs to twelve characters and drop the URL column where the row already identifies the item ([#115](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/115)).
- Tokens in the system keyring move to the service `gitea-cli:HOST[/PATH]` with the account name, so they can be found in Keychain Access and similar tools. Existing tokens are moved the first time 2.0 uses them; gt 1.x cannot read moved tokens ([#124](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/124)).
- `gt config set` with an unknown key now stores it with a warning instead of failing ([#124](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/124)).
- A 403 for a missing token scope now exits 4 (`authentication`) instead of 1 ([#123](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/123)).
- Polling commands (`run watch`, `run logs --follow`, `workflow run --follow`, `pr checks --watch`, `notification watch`) require `--interval` of at least 1s ([#122](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/122)).
- `go install` is no longer a supported way to install gt: the module stays at `gitea.dev/cli`, so `go install …@latest` keeps resolving to 1.x. Use a release binary, a package or the install script ([#118](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/118)).

## Features

- `gt issue create --blocked-by` and `--blocking` set dependencies on the new issue, `gt label list` takes `--search`, `--sort`, `--order` and `--web`, and `gt repo list` takes `--visibility`, `--archived`, `--no-archived`, `--topic` and `--language` ([#99](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/99)).
- Settings files from a later gt, or with settings this version does not know, are read and kept when gt rewrites them, so several gt versions can share one configuration ([#124](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/124)).
- A `GITEA_TOKEN` without the `read:user` scope now works for every command that does not need to know whose token it is, and so does the git credential helper. `gt auth login --help` and `gt help environment` explain which scopes a token needs ([#123](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/123)).
- Issue and pull request JSON gains `locked`, and pull request JSON gains `pinned`. `gt pr view` tells a deleted head branch or open blockers apart from conflicts ([#120](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/120)).
- `gt extension list` marks a local extension whose executable no longer exists ([#119](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/119)).
- `gt schema` marks date-time fields ([#127](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/127)).

## Security

- Local extensions run only when their executable, or what it links to, is a regular file owned by you or root that not every user can write to or replace ([#119](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/119)).
- The commit an extension install resolves must be a full commit ID before it is shown or passed to git ([#119](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/119)).
- `--debug` strips control characters from transport errors, which can quote server text ([#119](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/119)).
- `gt run download` checks every artifact name before writing anything, also when extracting into directories ([#119](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/119)).
- A job log that is missing no longer prints the server's raw error, which could include its storage path ([#122](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/122)).

## Fixes

- `secret set` and `variable set` refuse values that are not valid UTF-8 instead of silently changing them ([#119](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/119)).
- `gt issue create --blocked-by/--blocking` refuses a missing issue before creating the new one ([#120](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/120)).
- Pin, unpin, lock and unlock on an issue or pull request already in that state report it and change nothing, instead of a server error ([#120](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/120)).
- Merging a pull request blocked by an open dependency names the blocking issues instead of a server error ([#120](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/120)).
- `gt commit pr` prints the pull request without `--json` and accepts abbreviated SHAs ([#120](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/120)).
- `gt pr checks --required` names the base branch when its protection requires no checks, `gt status --json` prints `mentions: []` instead of `null`, `gt pr review --pending` and `gt pr review reply` report a missing body correctly, and `gt time cancel` no longer asks to discard a stopwatch that is not running ([#120](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/120)).
- `repo edit --dry-run` with topic flags, and `repo delete`/`repo archive` with `--dry-run` in a clone, no longer fail ([#121](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/121)).
- `repo archive` with several repositories checks every argument before archiving any, `repo create --team` checks its owner before any request, and `repo list --archived=false` is honoured ([#121](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/121)).
- `tag list` and `tag create` JSON fill the tagger and verification fields, and `tag protect` warns when Gitea leaves out users or teams ([#121](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/121)).
- A case-only rename of an organization's owner team is refused before it reaches Gitea, `gpg-key verify` accepts the numeric ID shown by `gpg-key list`, and `release download` skips an asset whose name cannot be a file name instead of downloading nothing ([#121](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/121)).
- `gt run watch` and `gt workflow run --follow` work on servers that cannot list workflows or jobs, as `gt run view` does ([#122](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/122)).
- `gt run logs` reports a job whose logs are missing, for example removed by retention, and goes on with the other jobs ([#122](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/122)).
- The missing-runner hint also covers queued jobs after other jobs started, `runner view --global` no longer claims a runner belongs to the instance, `project … --account` errors no longer name an empty repository, and `run cancel --force --dry-run` refuses a completed run ([#122](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/122)).

## Build

- Tags such as `v2.0.0-rc1` are published as pre-releases and no longer move the Docker `latest` tag, and version comparison orders pre-releases before their release, so `gt upgrade` and the update notice see 2.0.0 as newer than 2.0.0-rc1 ([#118](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/118)).
- The release workflow of a new Go extension (`gt extension create --precompiled=go`) installs the released gt instead of running `go run …@latest` ([#118](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/118)).
- Update the Go toolchain to 1.27.4 ([#109](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/109)).

## Internal

- Transport timeout tests run on a fake clock, so they no longer fail on a busy machine, such as during a `makepkg` check ([#110](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/110), fixes [#108](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/issues/108)).
- Dependency updates, including `golang.org/x/crypto` v0.59.0, `golang.org/x/oauth2` v0.38.0 and `github.com/spf13/pflag` v1.1.0, and Gitea 28.4.0 for the integration tests ([#116](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/116), [#128](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/128)).

## Contributors
* @bircni
* @lunny

**Full Changelog**: [v1.2.0...v2.0.0](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/compare/v1.2.0...v2.0.0)

body.name: v1.2.0
body.body:
gt 1.2.0 adds commands for commits, tags, activity feeds, stopwatches and branch protection rules, more of the `gh` options on the pull request, release, run and api commands, and makes commands run inside a clone about twice as fast.


### Features
- `gt commit` reads commits on the server with `list`, `view`, `diff`, `compare`, `status` and `pr`, where a ref is a SHA, branch or tag. `status` exits 1 when a status failed and 8 while one is pending, so `gt commit status main && deploy` waits for green ([#92](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/92)).
- `gt commit diff` and `gt pr diff` filter a diff with `--path` and `--exclude`, which take a file, a `dir/` or a glob and can be repeated, and summarize it with `--name-only`, `--name-status` and `--stat`. What is left is still a diff that `git apply` takes ([#92](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/92)).
- `gt tag` lists, views, creates and deletes tags without a clone, and `protect`, `unprotect` and `protection list` manage tag protection rules. `create --message` makes an annotated tag ([#93](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/93)).
- `gt branch protection list` and `view` show the protection rules in the order Gitea applies them: the approvals, who may push, the status checks and the other protections that are on ([#95](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/95)).
- `gt activity [<owner>]` shows the activity feed of a user or organization, yours without an owner, and `gt repo activity` that of a repository. `--date` keeps one day and `--only-performed-by` keeps what the user did ([#100](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/100)).
- `gt time start`, `stop`, `cancel` and `status` work with the issue stopwatch. `stop` logs the elapsed time, `cancel` discards it and `status` lists every active stopwatch across repositories ([#101](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/101)).
- `gt pr merge --admin` merges past the branch protection, for those who administer the repository. `--match-head-commit SHA` merges only while the head is still that commit, and `--disable-auto` cancels the merge that `--auto` scheduled ([#97](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/97)).
- `gt pr checks --required` shows and awaits only the checks that the protection rule of the base branch requires, so a flaky optional check no longer holds `--watch` back ([#97](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/97)).
- `gt pr create --fill-first` takes the title and body from the first commit of the branch, and `--fill-verbose` takes the body from the full message of every commit ([#97](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/97)).
- `gt release list` takes `--exclude-drafts`, `--exclude-pre-releases` and `--order asc|desc`, which sorts by when the releases were published ([#98](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/98)).
- `gt run view --log-failed` prints the logs of the jobs that failed or were canceled, and `--job NAME|ID` views one job or, with `--log`, prints its log ([#98](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/98)).
- `gt api --paginate --slurp` prints the pages as one JSON array, so a script parses one document ([#98](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/98)).

### Performance
- Commands run inside a clone are about twice as fast: `gt pr status`, `gt pr view`, `gt pr checks` and `gt status` take roughly half the time. Git is asked once per command instead of up to 11 times, and list pages and independent searches are read concurrently ([#103](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/103)).

### Fixes
- `gt upgrade --nightly` and the nightly option of the install scripts no longer fail with a checksum mismatch or install an old build. Nightly builds are now published to `gitea-cli/main-nightly`, which is not cached for a year. The 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 binaries still look in the old location, so upgrade to 1.2.0 before using `--nightly` again ([#102](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/102)).
- On Windows, gt no longer fails to read its settings while another gt process is writing them ([#105](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/105)).

### Documentation
- The README lists the official `gitea-cli` package in the Arch Linux extra repository: `sudo pacman -S gitea-cli` ([#96](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/96)).

### Internal
- Integration tests cover `gt runner`, `gt gpg-key`, locking, pinning, deleting, dependencies, `--template` and `--dry-run` on a real Gitea ([#94](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/94)).
- The golangci-lint configuration matches Gitea's, and `make fmt` runs `golangci-lint fmt` ([#104](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/104)).
- Update `charm.land/bubbletea/v2` to v2.1.1, which includes a security fix for terminal size reports, and `github.com/itchyny/gojq` to v0.12.20 ([#107](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/107)).
- Fix a flaky test that counted requests during concurrent page reads ([#106](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/106)).


## Contributors
* @lunny
* @bircni
* @silverwind
* @TheFox0x7

**Full Changelog**: [v1.1.0...v1.2.0](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0)

body.name: v1.1.0
body.body:
gt 1.1.0 adds a preview for almost every change, Go templates for output, a machine-readable list of JSON fields, and new commands for GPG keys, issues, pull requests and administration.
There are no breaking changes.
gt still supports Gitea 28 and newer; a command that needs a newer Gitea now says so before sending any request ([#67](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/67)).

### Features
- `--dry-run` shows the write requests a command would send, without sending them, on about 149 commands: every command that only changes Gitea. Reads still go through, secrets are shown as `[REDACTED]`, and `--json` prints the requests as a report. Commands that also change the local clone or gt's settings, such as `gt pr create` and `gt repo clone`, don't take it ([#73](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/73), [#87](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/87)).
- `--template` formats JSON output with a Go template, with the functions of `gh` such as `tablerow`, `timeago`, `color` and `hyperlink`. It takes the same `--json` field list; see `gt help formatting` ([#88](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/88)).
- `gt schema` lists the JSON fields of every command, and a check in CI keeps existing fields from being removed ([#72](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/72)).
- `GITEA_CLI_ERROR_FORMAT=json` reports failures as JSON on stderr, for scripts and agents ([#71](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/71)).
- `gt gpg-key` lists, views, adds and deletes GPG keys, and verifies them with `token` and `verify`. `create --signature-file` adds a key that names no activated email address of your account ([#81](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/81)).
- `gt issue lock`, `unlock`, `pin`, `unpin` and `delete` work on several issues at once. `delete` looks at every issue first and asks once for the batch ([#82](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/82)).
- `gt pr lock`, `unlock`, `pin`, `unpin` and `delete` select a pull request like `gt pr close`. `delete` takes a branch only for an open pull request, so a closed or merged one needs its number or URL ([#89](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/89)).
- `gt pr edit` and `gt issue edit` change dependencies in both directions with `--add-blocked-by`, `--remove-blocked-by`, `--add-blocks` and `--remove-blocks`. `gt pr view` and `gt pr edit` output `blocked_by` and `blocks` with `--json` ([#90](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/90)).
- `--select` on `gt issue list`, `gt pr list`, `gt release list` and `gt repo list` lets you pick an item on a terminal, shows it and runs the action you choose ([#86](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/86)).
- `gt notification list --all-accounts` lists the notifications of every account you are logged in to ([#85](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/85)).
- `gt repo license` and `gt repo gitignore` list and print the templates Gitea offers for new repositories, so `gt repo gitignore view Go >> .gitignore` works ([#83](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/83)).
- `gt project workflow` lists, views, creates, edits, enables, disables and deletes the workflows of a project board. It needs Gitea 29 ([#61](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/61)).
- `gt admin` adds `user rename`, `user key`, `user badge`, `org list`, `org create`, `cron list`, `cron run` and `email list` ([#78](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/78)).

### Internal
- The Windows tests run on every pull request ([#79](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/79)).
- Update `gitea.dev/sdk` to v1.5.1 ([#61](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/61)).
- Fix a flaky test that counted requests during concurrent column reads ([#84](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/pulls/84)).

## Contributors
* @lunny
* @bircni
* @silverwind

**Full Changelog**: [v1.0.0...v1.1.0](https://gitea.com/gitea/cli/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0)
